title: heterotis pygmaea
intro: Heterotis pygmaea, commonly known as the Dwarf Heterotis, is a plant species that belongs to the family Apocynaceae and is native to tropical Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, helping to alleviate conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Heterotis pygmaea include its ability to act as an expectorant, relieving congestion and promoting the discharge of mucus, as well as its analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
